kindDesc.bug: Code defect — runs Devon spec → dev autopilot

placeholder.devon: e.g. The real bug is the SSE reconnect logic; the user sees the symptom but the root cause is in orb-live.ts. Touch only the reconnect bucket. Add a unit test for the single-utterance case.
placeholder.sage: e.g. The answer should mention the new beta opt-in flow on /settings, not the legacy toggle.
placeholder.atlas: e.g. This claim is borderline fraud — start with an eligibility check, hold any refund pending operator review.
placeholder.mira: e.g. Verify the user's email first; the role corruption is likely a stale OAuth claim, not a DB issue.
placeholder.default: Your direction for the work item.
